records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Willow Labs!
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old, first_project reached 8/19 and 1 invite sent, and Nora replied positively (email:d01b6ef9) saying all good, suggesting continued use. But key_milestone still unreached, an API pagination ticket is open (tick_1ef0aac41d99, email:396b519a), and she only said "at some point" about a call -- low urgency with 8 days left.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Glad the first week has gone smoothly -- and yes, let's get that walkthrough on the calendar. Would a short call this week work? I'll keep it to the bits that matter for Willow Labs.

On your open ticket about the accounts endpoint: list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, and support will confirm the details in that thread.

In the meantime, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield and tasks live inside them, so if you'd like a hand getting your team's work mapped into that structure, just say the word.

Best,
Priya
